study: Post-hoc validation-threshold sensitivity of frozen Tuesday CICFlowMeter MLPs
scope: Separate analysis; does not replace original argmax results or create a new untouched test set
training: Forbidden; consume saved logits, labels and row identifiers only
score: m = float64(logit1) - float64(logit0), from saved FP32 logits
baseline: Original argmax: class 1 iff m > 0; equal logits select class 0
selected_rule: class 1 iff m >= t; otherwise class 0
objective: Maximize ordinary binary intrusion F1 over saved validation rows only, separately for each frozen model
candidate_set: Every distinct validation margin, including all tied-score rows together, plus nextafter(max_margin,+infinity) for the all-negative decision
ties: Compare F1 rational values exactly with integer cross-products; prefer fewer false positives, then the largest threshold
undefined_metrics: Undefined precision/recall remain null; validation must contain both ground-truth classes
threshold_storage: Store float64 decimal and hexadecimal values; inference uses the exact stored float64 margin threshold
softmax_display: sigmoid(m), computed stably, for interpretation only; it is not a calibrated probability or the optimization variable
freeze: Write/hash both thresholds, protocol, validation predictions and curves before reading/parsing test predictions or test truth
test: Apply each selected threshold once to the existing frozen saved test margins; do not sweep thresholds or optimize on test labels. Exclusive evaluation-start marker prevents a second evaluation in the same analysis directory.
audit: Read saved decisions to verify row identity, inequalities, count formulas, scikit-learn metrics and source/threshold preservation; auditing saved decisions is not a second threshold search
diagnostics: Report validation and test class-conditional margin/softmax quantiles, zero-boundary and selected-boundary counts, ROC-AUC, AP, recovery of original false negatives, new false positives and per-category recall. Only validation F1-versus-threshold curves may be plotted.
uncertainty: 2000 paired frozen-test-component bootstrap draws for B-minus-A F1 at the selected thresholds; seed=20261111. Conditional on fixed thresholds/models and imperfect original grouping, not campaign independent or a training-seed interval.
interpretation: The analysis was requested after the original test results were observed. Validation-only fitting avoids direct test-label threshold optimization, but this is exploratory reuse of the same test set, not confirmatory evidence from a newly untouched cohort.
production: No eBPF, model, scaler, dataset split, live demo, network configuration, existing report or prior result is modified
